This is my room.
It is just before seven in the morning.
I am alone, and of course neither Kohaku nor Akiha is here.
“Hah…”
Yes, I know.
I know it was a dream. Calmly considered, Akiha and the others could never have come to me and done such things.
That fact alone renders yesterday’s events impossible.
